Process-wide exact driver identity registry per live database, with a single child registry/mutex reset

Reject control-file hardlinks and live database inode aliases before raw open
regressions: Actual spawned POSIX byte-lock probes before/after independent journal close plus unlocked positive control
Bounded multithreaded fork test verifies inherited read/claim/close/lease handles deny without hanging
